tagline.en: Through the Qinling and up the Hengduan ranges: the mountain radial to the south-west
tagline.zh: 穿秦岭、攀横断山：通往西南的山地放射线

start.en: Xiaotun interchange in Wuhua district, Kunming, on the West and North Second Ring Roads
start.zh: 云南省昆明市五华区小屯立交桥，接二环西路、二环北路

end.en: Dayuancun Bridge in Fangshan district, Beijing, where the main line meets the Beijing–Kunming connector; the main line further into the city has not yet been built
end.zh: 北京市房山区大苑村桥，主线在此与京昆联络线相接；向城区延伸的主线尚待建设

en: G5 is the capital's radial to the south-west, 2,716 km through six provinces: down the Hebei plain past Baoding to Shijiazhuang, west through the Taihang mountains to Yangquan and Taiyuan, south down the Fen valley by Linfen to the Yellow River at Yumenkou, across the Guanzhong plain to Xi'an, over the Qinling to Hanzhong, through Guangyuan, Mianyang and Chengdu, and then up the eastern edge of the Hengduan mountains by Ya'an, Xichang and Panzhihua before dropping south to Kunming.

Sichuan holds the largest share, 1,037 km, and the hardest ground. Unlike the radials to the north-east and south-east, G5 is a mountain road for long stretches: in Shaanxi the Xi'an–Hanzhong section has bridges and tunnels for 66 per cent of its length, and in Sichuan the Ya'an–Xichang section 55 per cent.
zh: G5 是首都向西南方向的放射线，途经六个省市，全长 2,716 公里：沿河北平原经保定至石家庄，西穿太行山至阳泉、太原，沿汾河谷地南下经临汾，在禹门口跨过黄河，横越关中平原至西安，翻越秦岭至汉中，经广元、绵阳、成都，再沿横断山脉东缘经雅安、西昌、攀枝花攀升，最后南下昆明。
四川段最长，为 1,037 公里，地形也最险。与通往东北、东南的放射线不同，G5 很多路段都是山区高速：陕西西汉段桥隧比达 66%，四川雅西段为 55%。

en: The Xi'an–Hanzhong expressway crosses the main ridge of the Qinling through three long twin-bore tunnels — Qinling No. 1 at 6,144 metres, No. 2 at 6,125 and No. 3 at 4,950 — which cost 1.55 billion yuan together and were holed through on 20 May 2005. The 255 km section as a whole has 411 bridges and 130 tunnels.

The Ya'an–Xichang expressway, nicknamed the 'ladder to heaven', climbs from the edge of the Sichuan basin into the Hengduan mountains across the Qingyi, Dadu and Anning river systems and twelve earthquake fault zones. Its 240 km have 25 tunnels totalling about 41 km. The Nibashan tunnel under the Daxiangling range, almost 10 km long with up to 1,650 metres of rock overhead, crosses fifteen major faults; it was holed through in December 2011.

To gain height near Shimian, the road loops inside the mountain. The Tiezhaizi No. 1 and Ganhaizi tunnels are a double helix with a 600-metre turning radius, the first of their kind on a highway anywhere according to their builders, joined by the Ganhaizi bridge — 1,811 metres long in 36 spans at 2,500 metres altitude, with piers up to 110 metres high, built throughout as a concrete-filled steel-tube truss.

In Shanxi the Taiyuan–Yangquan section, built in 2010–2011, was the province's first six-lane expressway, with about 23 km of tunnels; the longest, Dananshan, is about 5.5 km. South of Xichang the Xichang–Panzhihua section has structures for 37 per cent of its 161.8 km and crosses the Jinsha River on a 1,390-metre bridge.
zh: 西汉高速穿越秦岭主梁，靠的是三座特长双洞隧道——秦岭Ⅰ号隧道 6,144 米、Ⅱ号 6,125 米、Ⅲ号 4,950 米，隧道群总投资 15.5 亿元，2005 年 5 月 20 日全线贯通。255 公里的西汉段共有桥梁 411 座、隧道 130 座。
雅西高速被称为「天梯高速」，自四川盆地边缘爬升进入横断山区，跨越青衣江、大渡河、安宁河等水系和 12 条地震断裂带。240 公里中有隧道 25 座、总长约 41 公里。横穿大相岭的泥巴山隧道长近 10 公里，最大埋深 1,650 米，穿越 15 条大断层，2011 年 12 月贯通。
为了在石棉一带爬升高度，道路在山体内部盘旋。铁寨子 1 号隧道与干海子隧道构成转弯半径 600 米的双螺旋隧道，据建设方称是世界公路史上首创；两隧道之间以干海子大桥相连——桥长 1,811 米，共 36 跨，海拔 2,500 米，最高桥墩 110 米，全桥采用钢管混凝土桁架梁结构。
山西太阳段 2010—2011 年建设，是山西省第一条双向六车道高速公路，隧道总长约 23 公里，最长的大南山隧道约 5.5 公里。西昌以南的西攀段全长 161.8 公里，桥隧长度占 37%，并以长 1,390 米的金沙江特大桥跨越金沙江。

en: The number dates from the '7918' national plan of January 2005, which counts the Beijing radials clockwise from due north, making the south-western line G5. The road it names was built in pieces by the provinces from the late 1990s, starting in the Sichuan basin: Chengdu–Mianyang opened on 21 December 1998, Chengdu–Ya'an on 4 January 2000, Lugu–Huanglianguan near Xichang in November 2000 and Mianyang–Guangyuan on 27 December 2002.

The difficult middle sections followed. Shaanxi's 625 km were complete when the Xi'an–Hanzhong expressway opened on 30 September 2007, after a construction period that began with the Qinling tunnels in 2002, before the project had formal state approval, and was lengthened when the line was moved away from a planned reservoir on the Han-to-Wei water-transfer scheme. Xichang–Panzhihua opened on 28 September 2008 and Panzhihua–Tianfang to the Yunnan border on 31 December 2008; Guangyuan–Shaanxi border on 23 May 2011; and Ya'an–Xichang, the last gap in Sichuan, on 28 April 2012, after five years' work.

The northern end came last. Laishui–Shijiazhuang had opened in 2008 under the name of the Zhangjiakou–Shijiazhuang expressway; the Beijing section to Laishui opened on 25 December 2014, and the 65 km from Shijiazhuang to the Shanxi border on 22 December 2015. The road's entry into Kunming opened on 11 November 2019.
zh: G5 这个编号来自 2005 年 1 月公布的「7918 网」：首都放射线自正北起按顺时针方向编号，西南方向的这一条便是 G5。它所串起的道路由各省自 1990 年代后期分段修建，最先从四川盆地开始：成绵高速 1998 年 12 月 21 日通车，成雅高速 2000 年 1 月 4 日通车，西昌附近的泸黄高速 2000 年 11 月通车，绵广高速 2002 年 12 月 27 日通车。

随后是难度最大的中段。2007 年 9 月 30 日西汉高速通车，京昆高速陕西境内 625 公里全线贯通；该路 2002 年在国家尚未正式批复立项时即以秦岭隧道群等控制性工程先期开工，后因线位与引汉济渭工程的水库交叉而「改路保水」，工期因此拉长。西攀高速 2008 年 9 月 28 日通车，攀枝花至川滇界的攀田高速 2008 年 12 月 31 日通车；广元至川陕界的广陕高速 2011 年 5 月 23 日通车；四川境内最后的缺口雅西高速历时五年，于 2012 年 4 月 28 日建成通车。
最后完成的是北端。涞水至石家庄段 2008 年以张石高速的名义通车；北京至涞水段 2014 年 12 月 25 日通车；石家庄至冀晋界 65 公里于 2015 年 12 月 22 日通车。昆明入城段于 2019 年 11 月 11 日通车。

en: No total has been published. The mountain sections are where the money went, and their costs are public: 13.88 billion yuan budgeted for the 255 km of Xi'an–Hanzhong, about 54 million a kilometre; 14.37 billion budgeted for the 124 km Taiyuan–Yangquan section; 8.895 billion for the 161.8 km of Xichang–Panzhihua; and for Ya'an–Xichang a preliminary-design budget of 16.4 billion approved by the Ministry of Communications and a total investment of about 20.6 billion.

The financing varied by province. Ya'an–Xichang drew a US$500 million loan from the Asian Development Bank. Xi'an–Hanzhong was built by a company set up for the purpose in 2002 by Shaanxi's provincial expressway construction group, which also operates it. Chengdu–Ya'an is run by Sichuan Expressway Company, listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai. All of it is tolled; on Xi'an–Hanzhong a car pays a 20-yuan surcharge for the Qinling tunnels on top of the distance toll.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。钱主要花在山区路段，这些路段的造价是公开的：西汉段 255 公里概算总投资 138.78 亿元，平均每公里约 5,425 万元；太阳段 124 公里投资概算 143.745 亿元；西攀段 161.8 公里总投资 88.95 亿元；雅西段交通部批复初步设计概算 164 亿元，总投资约 206 亿元。
各省的筹资方式不尽相同。雅西高速利用了亚洲开发银行贷款 5 亿美元。西汉高速由陕西省高速公路建设集团公司于 2002 年出资设立的陕西西汉高速公路有限责任公司作为项目法人建设并运营。成雅高速由在香港和上海上市的四川成渝高速公路股份有限公司管理。全线收费；在西汉高速上，小客车除按里程收费外，还需另付秦岭隧道群加收费 20 元。

en: Through the Qinling the limit on Xi'an–Hanzhong is 80 km/h, and the Ya'an–Xichang section is designed for 80 km/h. On 10 August 2017 a coach struck the portal of Qinling No. 1 tunnel, killing 36 people.
zh: 西汉高速秦岭段限速每小时 80 公里，雅西段设计时速 80 公里。2017 年 8 月 10 日，一辆客车在秦岭一号隧道洞口发生撞击，造成 36 人死亡。

why.en: No total has been published. G5 was built from the late 1990s to 2019 as many separately financed provincial projects, each accounted for on its own; sourced section figures are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G5 在 1990 年代后期至 2019 年间由众多分别筹资的省级项目建成，各自单独核算；下列为有来源的分段数字。

value.en: 13.878 billion yuan budgeted for 255 km, about 54.25 million a kilometre (2002–2007); the three Qinling tunnels 1.55 billion of it
value.zh: 255 公里概算总投资 138.78 亿元，平均每公里约 5,425 万元（2002—2007）；其中秦岭隧道群 15.5 亿元

value.en: The six provinces and municipalities, through provincial expressway companies, repaid from tolls; an Asian Development Bank loan of US$500 million for Ya'an–Xichang. No World Bank loan is recorded for G5 in the sources consulted.
value.zh: 沿线六省市通过各自的高速公路公司出资，以通行费还贷；雅西段利用亚洲开发银行贷款 5 亿美元。所查来源中未见 G5 使用世界银行贷款的记载。

timeline.zh: 12 月 21 日，成绵高速通车。
1 月 4 日，成雅高速通车。

timeline.en: Mianyang–Guangyuan opens on 27 December; work on the Qinling tunnels of Xi'an–Hanzhong begins in September.
timeline.zh: 9 月，西汉高速秦岭隧道群等控制性工程先期开工；12 月 27 日绵广高速通车。

timeline.en: The '7918' plan numbers the route G5; the Qinling tunnels are holed through on 20 May.
timeline.zh: 「7918 网」规划将该线编为 G5；5 月 20 日秦岭隧道群全线贯通。

timeline.en: Xi'an–Hanzhong opens on 30 September, completing the 625 km in Shaanxi.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日，西汉高速通车，陕西境内 625 公里全线贯通。

timeline.en: Xichang–Panzhihua opens on 28 September and Panzhihua–Tianfang on 31 December; Laishui–Shijiazhuang opens in November.
timeline.zh: 9 月 28 日西攀高速通车，11 月涞水至石家庄段通车，12 月 31 日攀田高速通车。

timeline.en: Ya'an–Xichang, the 'ladder to heaven', opens on 28 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 28 日，「天梯高速」雅西高速建成通车。

timeline.en: The Beijing–Laishui section opens on 25 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 25 日，北京至涞水段通车。

timeline.en: Shijiazhuang to the Shanxi border opens on 22 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 22 日，石家庄至冀晋界段通车。

timeline.en: A coach crash at the Qinling No. 1 tunnel on 10 August kills 36.
timeline.zh: 8 月 10 日，秦岭一号隧道洞口发生客车撞击事故，36 人死亡。

timeline.en: The entry into Kunming opens on 11 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 11 日，昆明入城段通车。
